name: immoweb-keeper
description: Create your own long term database of Immoweb photos and metadata based on criterias
author: Laurent Sylvain Vleminckx

scripts.dev:routine: npm run dev:db:start && npm run routine --prefix server
scripts.dev: npm run dev:db:start && concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" --names "server,client" --prefix "{name} ~>" --prefix-colors "green,blue"
scripts.prod:deploy: npm run prod:check && docker compose --env-file deploy/config.prod.env -f compose.prod.yaml up -d --build --wait app
scripts.prod:restart: docker compose --env-file deploy/config.prod.env -f compose.prod.yaml restart app
scripts.prod:logs: docker compose --env-file deploy/config.prod.env -f compose.prod.yaml logs -f app mongodb
scripts.prod:routine: npm run prod:check && docker compose --env-file deploy/config.prod.env -f compose.prod.yaml run --rm routine
